title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 18.8 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab EE versions from 18.8 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 could allow an authenticated user to access GitLab Duo features restricted by group-based access rules. This occurs due to improper handling of failed updates to those rules. The issue has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
